sub_graphs.title: Spurious Dragon: Empty Account State Clearing
sub_graphs.description: Models the EIP-161 state clearing mechanism that removes empty accounts

nodes.label: Account Touched in Transaction
nodes.description: An account has been accessed or modified during transaction execution

nodes.label: Check if Account Empty
nodes.description: Verify if account has zero balance, zero nonce, and empty code

nodes.label: Account is Empty
nodes.description: Account meets empty criteria: balance=0, nonce=0, code=empty

nodes.label: Account is Not Empty
nodes.description: Account has non-zero balance, nonce, or code

nodes.label: Delete Empty Account
nodes.description: Remove empty account from state trie entirely

nodes.label: Account Deleted from State
nodes.description: Empty account has been removed from world state

edges.label: Transaction touches account via transfer or call

sub_graphs.title: Spurious Dragon: Contract Code Size Limit
sub_graphs.description: Models the EIP-170 contract code size validation (24KB limit)

nodes.label: Contract Creation Pending
nodes.description: CREATE or CREATE2 operation about to deploy new contract

nodes.label: Execute Init Code
nodes.description: Run contract initialization code to produce runtime bytecode

nodes.label: Runtime Code Produced
nodes.description: Init code has returned runtime bytecode

nodes.label: Check Code Size Limit
nodes.description: Verify runtime bytecode does not exceed 24576 bytes (24KB)

nodes.label: Code Size Within Limit
nodes.description: Runtime code is 24KB or less - deployment can proceed

nodes.label: Code Size Limit Exceeded
nodes.description: Runtime code exceeds 24KB - deployment fails

nodes.label: Deploy Contract Code
nodes.description: Store runtime bytecode at contract address

nodes.label: Contract Deployed
nodes.description: Contract successfully created with runtime code

nodes.label: Revert Contract Creation
nodes.description: Fail deployment and consume all gas

nodes.label: Contract Creation Failed
nodes.description: Contract deployment rejected due to size limit

external_entities.name: EVM Contract Creation
external_entities.description: CREATE or CREATE2 opcode triggering contract deployment

sub_graphs.title: Spurious Dragon: EXP Opcode Gas Repricing
sub_graphs.description: Models the EIP-160 gas cost increase for EXP opcode

nodes.label: EXP Opcode Encountered
nodes.description: EVM interpreter encounters EXP (0x0a) opcode

nodes.label: Read Exponent from Stack
nodes.description: Pop exponent value from EVM stack

nodes.label: Calculate Exponent Byte Size
nodes.description: Determine number of bytes needed to represent exponent

nodes.label: Compute Dynamic Gas Cost
nodes.description: Calculate gas: 10 + 50 * byte_size_of_exponent (increased from 10 + 10 * byte_size)

nodes.label: Deduct Gas
nodes.description: Subtract computed gas cost from remaining gas

nodes.label: Gas Deducted
nodes.description: Gas cost for EXP operation has been charged

nodes.label: Out of Gas
nodes.description: Insufficient gas for EXP operation

ambiguities.text: The index page does not show specific implementation details of state clearing rules
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume EIP-161 standard behavior: empty accounts (balance=0, nonce=0, code=empty) are deleted when touched

ambiguities.text: Definition of 'touched' account is not visible in index
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume touched means any account accessed via CALL, CALLCODE, DELEGATECALL, STATICCALL, or receiving a transfer

implicit_assumptions.description: The 24KB code size limit applies only to newly deployed contracts, not existing ones
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Existing contracts over 24KB would become invalid, breaking deployed applications

implicit_assumptions.description: Block number is used to determine fork activation for rule changes
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Inconsistent fork activation across clients would cause network splits

implicit_assumptions.description: State bloat attacks were economically feasible before EIP-161 state clearing
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: The mitigation would be unnecessary if attack wasn't viable
